title: Revise M1 study design doc: fix BRIEF pin and verification evidence
summary: Retry of the rejected job: the design doc docs/design/study-capability-m1.md must pin BRIEF.md line references without citing a commit that exists only in Athena's rebuilt repo. Behavior criteria must be checkable with the allowed commands, and the final report must cite only commands that actually ran.

defaults_applied.how: The pin must work for a reader of the real repository, not only Athena's rebuilt history.
Line citations must be verified against the current BRIEF.md.
Behavior criteria use only commands the verifier can run.

assumptions: The job id in the request has no readable record here, so the earlier request (an M1 study-capability design doc) and its findings define the scope.
The current doc already says line numbers refer to BRIEF.md 'as of this change'; I assume the earlier faults (unreal commit hash, nonexistent §8.1 reference) may still need fixing or re-verifying.
Real-repo-independent pinning is acceptable, e.g. the BRIEF.md content description or a statement relative to the change, with no hash from a rebuilt history.

acceptance_criteria.text: docs/design/study-capability-m1.md contains no commit hash that is absent from the real repository; the BRIEF.md pin names no synthetic base commit (grep for c6004fd returns nothing).
Every cross-reference in the doc resolves to an existing heading; no reference to a nonexistent subsection such as §8.1 remains.
BRIEF.md line citations in the doc match the BRIEF.md in the working tree, and the doc states how a reader can confirm the version they cite.
Run `git status` and `git diff --stat`: only the design doc (and optionally CHANGELOG.md) changed, and BRIEF.md, records/ and governance files are untouched.
Run `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy` and `cargo test`: all pass, since no Rust code changed.

out_of_scope: Changes to the design's substance beyond fixing pins and references
departures: Slightly lower cost than the reference, because the change is a narrow docs fix.
